a northern tributary of the Huai in central Henan.

a river of eastern Henan, a branch of the Ying; the modern Shahe joins Ying River at Zhoukou.
a state of the Ying and Huai country where Dong fought the Huaiyi; traditionally placed at Yancheng, Luohe, Henan, or at Fuyang, Anhui.
